test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is a good strategy of serving food, if you have to serve buffet food to around 150 guests in a family function? Note that this means the person has to hold the plate while standing and eating.

options.text: Banana leaves on washable and reusable plastic plates

solution:
The correct answer is __**Banana leaves on washable and reusable plastic plates**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Using banana leaves on washable and reusable plastic plates is eco-friendly as banana leaves are biodegradable.
 
• Banana leaves are large and sturdy, making them an ideal choice for holding food without spillage.
 
• The combination of banana leaves and plastic plates is hygienic since the leaves can be disposed of after use, and the plates can be washed and reused, reducing waste.
 
• This method is cost-effective for serving a large number of guests, as it minimizes the need for buying disposable plates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Banana leaves have been traditionally used in many cultures for serving food.
 
• They are biodegradable and eco-friendly but might be difficult to manage without any support structure.
 
• Banana leaves add an eco-friendly layer that can be easily disposed of after use.
